granules tend to decrease the sediment discharge in flows over dune-covered sand beds and to increase it in flows over flat sand beds.
granules have the effect of decreasing bed form amplitude and increasing sediment discharge in flows over dune-covered sand beds, and the opposite effect in flows over flat beds.

the addition of granules to sand-bed flows results in armouring of the bed and a decrease in sediment discharge.
